description: NaLaSiO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.76 Å. La is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.97 Å. Si is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.64 Å) and two longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent La, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, three equivalent La, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent La, and one Si atom.
